question: 2nd Largest Company end of August?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve to the second-largest company in the world by market cap on August 31, 2026, as of market close.

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

"Other" means any option not listed here.
research:
I found no single official data series. In mid-August 2026, Apple was in second place, about $0.2 trillion ahead of Alphabet and about $1 trillion behind Nvidia. The lead between Apple and Alphabet changed hands several times in 2026. I left out every source dated after 2026-08-16, including any month-end tables.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria give no URL, only "a consensus of credible reporting." In practice that means market-cap rankings such as companiesmarketcap.com and Yahoo's largest-companies screener, plus financial press.
- 2026-08-13: the latest pre-cutoff figures I found are Nvidia about $5.43T, Apple about $4.41T (second) and Alphabet about $4.18T, taken from a Quotient recap using Aug 12-13 data. [Quotient](https://signal.quotient.social/signals/464703ab-1411-4882-8af7-5e2bdc63bd63)
- 2026-08-12: the Motley Fool puts Apple at about $4.4T and Alphabet at about $4.2T. [Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/13/the-race-to-5-trillion-who-will-get-there-first-ap/)
- I could not find closing market caps for Aug 14-15.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. Apple holds second by roughly $0.2-0.25T, about 5%. A swing of a few percent between Apple and Alphabet over the remaining 11 trading days could flip the order.
- Nvidia led Apple by about $1T (about 20%) on Aug 12. Microsoft, Amazon and Aramco were well behind; I found no exact mid-August figures for them.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-13: Apple about $4.411T, still second ahead of Alphabet. [Quotient](https://signal.quotient.social/signals/464703ab-1411-4882-8af7-5e2bdc63bd63)
- 2026-08-13: Things weighing on Apple and Alphabet. [Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/13/the-race-to-5-trillion-who-will-get-there-first-ap/)
  - Apple: memory-chip costs are a headwind (Tim Cook called it a "100-year flood"), and John Ternus becomes CEO in September.
  - Alphabet: Q2 revenue rose 24% and Google Cloud grew 82%. It plans about $200B in data-center capital spending.
- 2026-08-11 to 08-12: the gap was about $147B on Aug 11 (Apple $4.498T, Alphabet $4.351T, Nvidia $5.269T) and about $230B on Aug 12. [Quotient](https://signal.quotient.social/signals/464703ab-1411-4882-8af7-5e2bdc63bd63)
- About 2026-08-05: one report said Alphabet briefly passed Apple, roughly $4.59T to $4.515T. Later data put Apple back in second. [Quotient](https://signal.quotient.social/signals/464703ab-1411-4882-8af7-5e2bdc63bd63)
- 2026-07-28: Apple touched $5T intraday and closed at $340.08. It had passed Nvidia the day before to become the most valuable company. Nvidia was up only about 6% for the year. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/28/apple-touches-5-trillion-market-cap-for-first-time-.html)
- 2026-07-26: commentators predicted Alphabet would reach $5T before Apple. [Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/07/26/prediction-alphabet-will-beat-apple-to-a-5-trillio/)
- 2026-01-08: Alphabet passed Apple for the first time since 2019, at $3.89T vs $3.85T. Nvidia was about $4.6T. [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-01-08/alphabet-overtakes-apple-becoming-second-to-nvidia-in-size), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/alphabet-overtakes-apple-as-worlds-second-most-valuable-company-behind-nvidia-154751861.html)

## 4. Base rates
- At least four of the top three places changed in 2026:
  - Alphabet passed Apple in January.
  - Apple passed Nvidia for first place in late July.
  - Nvidia was back on top by mid-August.
  - Alphabet briefly passed Apple around Aug 5.
- Typical moves:
  - Apple fell from about $5T (Jul 28) to about $4.4T (Aug 12), roughly 12% in two weeks.
  - Alphabet moved about 4% in a single day (Aug 11 to Aug 12, $4.35T to $4.18T).
  - Daily changes of $100-200B in the Apple-Alphabet gap are common, so a $0.2T gap is within normal two-week variation.
- For Nvidia to drop to second, it would need a relative fall of about 20% against Apple. That is less likely but not unprecedented, since Apple briefly passed it in late July.
- Microsoft, Amazon, Tesla and Aramco: I found no 2026 evidence of any of them near second place.

## 5. Other forecasts
These come from Polymarket mirror sites, not Polymarket itself. The snapshots are mostly from late July, and their dates and numbers disagree.
- Late July 2026: Apple about 51-53%, NVIDIA about 39%, Alphabet about 11%. [polymarkets.co.il](https://polymarkets.co.il/en/market/2nd-largest-company-end-of-august-20260715202554129/), [predscope](https://predscope.com/event/2nd-largest-company-end-of-august-20260715202554129)
- Undated aggregator snapshot: Apple 60.0%, Alphabet 14.2%, NVIDIA 6.5%. [PredictionHunt](https://www.predictionhunt.com/odds/2nd-largest-company-end-of-august/30889)
- Separate single-outcome mirrors: Saudi Aramco about 0%. [polyguana](https://polyguana.com/market/2941286)
- Around 2026-08-13: a Quotient forecaster treated Apple holding second as the base case. [Quotient](https://signal.quotient.social/signals/464703ab-1411-4882-8af7-5e2bdc63bd63)
- I could not get a live Polymarket price as of Aug 16.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-08-26 (after the close): Nvidia reports Q2 fiscal 2027 results. A big move could change the gap at the top, and AI-sector sentiment could move Alphabet too. [SEC 8-K listing](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000073/q2fy27pr.htm)
- Late August: possible Apple news ahead of its usual September iPhone event, the CEO handover to Ternus in September, and memory-cost headlines.
- Alphabet: AI and Cloud news, and any antitrust remedy rulings (I did not check for specific dates).
- Macro: Fed commentary in late August (Jackson Hole is usually held then) and the rotation between AI stocks and hardware stocks.
- Resolution uses the 2026-08-31 market close.

- **Aug 26:** Nvidia reports earnings. A sharp drop could close part of the roughly $1T gap. AI sentiment from those results would also move Alphabet, likely in the same direction as Nvidia.
- **Apple headwinds:** memory-chip costs and the CEO transition.
- **Alphabet tailwinds:** Cloud grew 82% and the stock has strong momentum.
- **Prediction-market mirrors (stale, undated):** Apple about 51-60%, Alphabet 11-14%, Nvidia 6-39%. These are unreliable but broadly agree that Apple is the favourite.

**(e) Unexpected scenario:** Nvidia misses its Aug 26 earnings or gives weak guidance and falls about 15-20%. At the same time Apple rallies on iPhone event hype, or Alphabet surges on AI and Cloud news. Nvidia then drops to second, behind Apple or Alphabet.

**Reasoning:**
- **Apple vs Alphabet:** The relative daily volatility between the two is about 2%, which is about 6.5% over 11 days. Against a 5% gap, that gives roughly a 22-25% chance that Alphabet passes Apple. Alphabet's momentum and Apple's headwinds push this slightly upward.
- **Nvidia in second:** This needs a relative swing of about 20%. Earnings make that more possible than usual, so I put it at about 5%.

I started from a status quo of about 75% for Apple and moved down to about 67% because of the narrow gap and recent swaps.
